capitals.name: Lobamba (royal and legislative capital; Mbabane is the executive capital)

ledger.x: 1885: Cliopatria's Swaziland row begins; the kingdom itself is older.
1894: Swaziland becomes a South African Republic protectorate.
October 1899: the South African Republic's protectorate lapses.

wars.name: Second Boer War (Swaziland)
wars.outcome: Swaziland was indirectly involved: British forces operated there and the Boers were expelled by February 1902; the South African Republic's protectorate ended in October 1899 and Britain took over in 1903.

certainty.note: The pages give no boundary description (not even for the 1881 and 1884 conventions that recognised Swazi independence); Cliopatria's outline is the modern country's, drawn back through the protectorate years.
The independent kingdom keeps the colonial boundary; the pages give no change.
